```{r}
library(dlnm)
library(splines)
library(MASS)

# Safe quasi-AIC function
qAIC <- function(model) {
  ll <- tryCatch(logLik(model), error = function(e) NA)
  if (is.na(ll)) return(NA)
  k <- attr(ll, "df")
  return(-2 * as.numeric(ll) + 2 * k)
}

# Variable grouping
met_vars <- c("HeatWaveDays", "MeanT", "AvgHum", "TotalRain_log", "WindSp_mph", "SolarRad")
pol_vars <- c("SO2_log", "NO2_sqrt", "CO_sqrt", "O3_log", "PM2.5_sqrt")

# Time covariate spline
df$DOS <- as.numeric(df$DOS)
ns.time <- ns(df$DOS, df = 21)

# Convert categorical variables to factors
df$Month <- as.factor(df$Month)
df$DOW <- as.factor(df$DOW)
df$Holiday <- as.factor(df$Holiday)

# Output list
results <- list()

# Loop over each predictor
for (var in c(met_vars, pol_vars)) {
  
  is_met <- var %in% met_vars
  max_lag <- ifelse(is_met, 30, 10)
  
  best_qAIC <- Inf
  best_combo <- NULL
  
  cat("\nEvaluating:", var, "\n")
  
  for (var_df in 2:3) {
    for (lag_df in 2:3) {
      
      # Build cross-basis
      cb <- tryCatch({
        crossbasis(df[[var]], lag = max_lag,
                   argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = var_df),
                   arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = lag_df))
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (is.null(cb)) next
      
      # Fit model
      model <- tryCatch({
        glm(DengueCases ~ cb + ns.time + Month + DOW + Holiday,
            family = quasipoisson(), data = df)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (is.null(model)) next
      
      # Compute qAIC
      q <- qAIC(model)
      cat("var_df:", var_df, "lag_df:", lag_df, "qAIC:", round(q, 2), "\n")
      
      if (!is.na(q) && q < best_qAIC) {
        best_qAIC <- q
        best_combo <- list(var = var, var_df = var_df, lag_df = lag_df, qAIC = q)
      }
    }
  }
  
  results[[var]] <- best_combo
}

# Print final result
cat("\nBest DOF combinations by variable:\n")
print(results)

```

```{r}
library(MASS)

# Initial AIC
current_aic <- AIC(model)

# Terms to try removing
terms_list <- c(#"cb_MaxT", 
                "cb_MeanT", "cb_AvgHum", 
                # "cb_AH", 
                "cb_TotalRain_log", "cb_WindSp_mph", "cb_SO2_log", "cb_NO2_log",  "cb_CO_log",
                "cb_O3_log", "cb_PM25_log", "factor(Month)", 
                # "factor(Season)", 
                "factor(DOW)", "factor(Holiday)")

# Backward elimination loop
repeat {
  aic_results <- data.frame(term=character(), AIC=double(), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

  for (term in terms_list) {
    # Try removing one term
    formula_new <- as.formula(paste("DengueCases ~ . -", term))
    model_new <- try(update(model, formula_new), silent=TRUE)

    # If model updates successfully, record AIC
    if (!inherits(model_new, "try-error")) {
      aic_results <- rbind(aic_results, data.frame(term=term, AIC=AIC(model_new)))
    }
  }

  # If no more terms can be removed, break
  if (nrow(aic_results) == 0) break

  # Find the term whose removal results in the lowest AIC
  best <- aic_results[which.min(aic_results$AIC), ]

  # Compare with current model AIC
  if (best$AIC < current_aic) {
    # Update model
    message("Removing term: ", best$term, " | New AIC: ", best$AIC)
    model <- update(model, as.formula(paste("~ . -", best$term)))
    current_aic <- best$AIC
    terms_list <- setdiff(terms_list, best$term)  # Remove from list
  } else {
    break  # Stop if no AIC improvement
  }
}

# Final model
summary(model)
```

#backward_elimination_quasi
```{r}
# Corrected function for backward elimination with quasipoisson
backward_elimination_quasi <- function(model, alpha = 0.05) {
  
  # Variables to protect (always keep in model) - use base names
  protected_vars <- c("ns(DOS, df = 7 * 6)", "factor(Month)", 
                     "factor(DOW)", "factor(Holiday)")
  
  while(TRUE) {
    # Get summary of current model
    model_summary <- summary(model)
    
    # Get coefficient names and p-values
    coef_names <- rownames(model_summary$coefficients)
    p_values <- model_summary$coefficients[, 4]  # 4th column contains p-values
    
    # Remove intercept from consideration
    non_intercept_indices <- which(coef_names != "(Intercept)")
    
    if(length(non_intercept_indices) == 0) {
      cat("No more variables can be removed.\n")
      break
    }
    
    # Group coefficients by their base variable names
    # Extract base variable names (before any numbers or factor levels)
    base_var_names <- character(length(coef_names))
    
    for(i in 1:length(coef_names)) {
      name <- coef_names[i]
      
      # Handle crossbasis variables
      if(grepl("^cb_", name)) {
        base_var_names[i] <- gsub("^(cb_[^0-9.]+).*", "\\1", name)
      }
      # Handle ns() terms
      else if(grepl("^ns\\(", name)) {
        base_var_names[i] <- gsub("^(ns\\([^)]+\\)).*", "\\1", name)
      }
      # Handle factor terms
      else if(grepl("^factor\\(", name)) {
        base_var_names[i] <- gsub("^(factor\\([^)]+\\)).*", "\\1", name)
      }
      # Handle other terms
      else {
        base_var_names[i] <- name
      }
    }
    
    # Find which variables can be removed (not protected and not intercept)
    removable_mask <- !base_var_names %in% c("(Intercept)", protected_vars) & 
                      coef_names != "(Intercept)"
    
    if(sum(removable_mask) == 0) {
      cat("No more variables can be removed (all remaining are protected).\n")
      break
    }
    
    # For each unique base variable, find the maximum p-value among its terms
    unique_base_vars <- unique(base_var_names[removable_mask])
    max_p_by_var <- numeric(length(unique_base_vars))
    names(max_p_by_var) <- unique_base_vars
    
    for(var in unique_base_vars) {
      var_indices <- which(base_var_names == var & removable_mask)
      max_p_by_var[var] <- max(p_values[var_indices], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    
    # Find variable with highest maximum p-value
    overall_max_p <- max(max_p_by_var, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # If all remaining variables are significant, stop
    if(overall_max_p <= alpha) {
      cat("All remaining variables are significant at alpha =", alpha, "\n")
      break
    }
    
    # Find variable to remove
    var_to_remove <- names(max_p_by_var)[which.max(max_p_by_var)]
    
    cat("Removing:", var_to_remove, "with max p-value:", overall_max_p, "\n")
    
    # Get current model terms
    current_terms <- attr(terms(model), "term.labels")
    
    # Find the exact term to remove from the model terms
    term_to_remove <- current_terms[grepl(paste0("^", gsub("([\\[\\]\\(\\)\\*\\+\\?\\^\\$\\|\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", var_to_remove)), current_terms)]
    
    if(length(term_to_remove) == 0) {
      # If exact match not found, try alternative matching
      if(grepl("^cb_", var_to_remove)) {
        term_to_remove <- current_terms[grepl(paste0("^", gsub("([\\[\\]\\(\\)\\*\\+\\?\\^\\$\\|\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", var_to_remove)), current_terms)]
      }
    }
    
    if(length(term_to_remove) > 0) {
      # Update model formula by removing the term
      current_formula <- formula(model)
      new_formula <- update(current_formula, paste(". ~ . -", "`", term_to_remove[1], "`", sep=""))
      
      # Fit new model
      tryCatch({
        model <- glm(new_formula, family = quasipoisson(), data = df)
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error updating model:", e$message, "\n")
        cat("Trying alternative removal method...\n")
        
        # Alternative: rebuild formula manually
        remaining_terms <- current_terms[!current_terms %in% term_to_remove]
        new_formula_str <- paste("DengueCases_sqrt ~", paste(remaining_terms, collapse = " + "))
        new_formula <- as.formula(new_formula_str)
        model <<- glm(new_formula, family = quasipoisson(), data = df)
      })
    } else {
      cat("Could not find term to remove. Stopping.\n")
      break
    }
  }
  
  return(model)
}

# Apply backward elimination
final_model <- backward_elimination_quasi(model, alpha = 0.05)
summary(final_model)
```

```{r}
# Simpler approach - manually check p-values and rebuild model
manual_backward_elimination <- function(model, alpha = 0.05) {
  
  current_model <- model
  
  # Get all terms from original model
  all_terms <- attr(terms(model), "term.labels")
  
  # Protected terms that should always stay
  protected_terms <- c("ns(DOS, df = 7 * 6)", "factor(Month)", 
                      "factor(DOW)", "factor(Holiday)")
  
  # Terms available for removal
  removable_terms <- setdiff(all_terms, protected_terms)
  
  while(length(removable_terms) > 0) {
    
    # Get model summary
    model_summary <- summary(current_model)
    
    # Calculate significance for each removable term
    term_significance <- numeric(length(removable_terms))
    names(term_significance) <- removable_terms
    
    for(term in removable_terms) {
      # Find coefficients related to this term
      coef_names <- rownames(model_summary$coefficients)
      
      if(grepl("^cb_", term)) {
        # For crossbasis terms, find all related coefficients
        related_coefs <- coef_names[grepl(paste0("^", gsub("([\\[\\]\\(\\)\\*\\+\\?\\^\\$\\|\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", term)), coef_names)]
      } else {
        # For other terms, find related coefficients
        related_coefs <- coef_names[grepl(gsub("([\\[\\]\\(\\)\\*\\+\\?\\^\\$\\|\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", term), coef_names)]
      }
      
      if(length(related_coefs) > 0) {
        # Get p-values for related coefficients
        p_vals <- model_summary$coefficients[related_coefs, 4]
        # Use maximum p-value (least significant)
        term_significance[term] <- max(p_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        term_significance[term] <- 0  # Keep in model if can't find
      }
    }
    
    # Find term with highest p-value
    max_p_value <- max(term_significance, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Check if we should stop
    if(max_p_value <= alpha) {
      cat("All remaining variables are significant at alpha =", alpha, "\n")
      break
    }
    
    # Remove term with highest p-value
    term_to_remove <- names(term_significance)[which.max(term_significance)]
    cat("Removing:", term_to_remove, "with max p-value:", max_p_value, "\n")
    
    # Update removable terms list
    removable_terms <- removable_terms[removable_terms != term_to_remove]
    
    # Rebuild model with remaining terms
    remaining_terms <- c(protected_terms, removable_terms)
    new_formula_str <- paste("DengueCases_sqrt ~", paste(remaining_terms, collapse = " + "))
    new_formula <- as.formula(new_formula_str)
    
    current_model <- glm(new_formula, family = quasipoisson(), data = df)
  }
  
  return(current_model)
}

# Apply the manual elimination
final_model <- manual_backward_elimination(model, alpha = 0.05)
summary(final_model)
```

```{r}
# Deviance of the model
deviance_val <- deviance(model)

# Number of parameters (including intercept)
num_params <- length(coef(model))

# Compute qAIC manually: qAIC = Deviance + 2 * Number of Parameters
qAIC_value <- deviance_val + 2 * num_params

# Print the qAIC
print(qAIC_value)
```

```{r}
# Step 1: Extract fitted values and observed values
mu_hat <- fitted(model)
y <- model$y

# Step 2: Compute quasi-likelihood
Q <- sum(y * log(mu_hat) - mu_hat)

# Step 3: Count number of estimated parameters
p <- length(coef(model))

# Step 4: Compute qAIC
qAIC <- -2 * Q + 2 * p

# Print result
qAIC
```


```{r}
dispersion <- summary(model)$dispersion
deviance <- model$deviance
edf <- length(coef(model))  # number of parameters

qloglik <- -deviance / (2 * dispersion)
qAIC <- -2 * qloglik + 2 * edf
qAIC
```

```{r}
# Initialize minimum qAIC and best parameters

best_params <- list()

# Loop over all combinations
for (Mlag in 26:34) {
  for (Mdof in 2:3) {
    for (Mknots in 2:3) {
      for (Plag in 6:12) {
        for (Pdof in 2:3) {
          for (Pknots in 2:3) {
            # Try-catch block in case model fitting fails for some combinations
            try({
              # Crossbasis for meteorological variables
              # cb_HeatWaveDays <- crossbasis(df$HeatWaveDays, lag=Mlag,
              #                               argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Mdof),
              #                               arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Mknots))
              cb_MeanT <- crossbasis(df$MeanT, lag=Mlag,
                                    argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Mdof),
                                    arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Mknots))
              cb_AvgHum <- crossbasis(df$AvgHum, lag=Mlag,
                                      argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Mdof),
                                      arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Mknots))
              cb_WindSp_mph <- crossbasis(df$WindSp_mph, lag=Mlag,
                                          argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Mdof),
                                          arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Mknots))
              cb_TotalRain_log <- crossbasis(df$TotalRain_log, lag=Mlag,
                                        argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Mdof),
                                        arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Mknots))

              # Crossbasis for pollution variables
              cb_SO2_log <- crossbasis(df$SO2_log, lag=Plag,
                                       argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                                       arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Pknots))
              cb_NO2_log <- crossbasis(df$NO2_log, lag=Plag,
                                        argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                                        arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Pknots))
              cb_NO_log <- crossbasis(df$NO_log, lag=Plag,
                                        argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                                        arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Pknots))
              cb_CO_log <- crossbasis(df$CO_sqrt, lag=Plag,
                                       argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                                       arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Pknots))
              cb_O3_log <- crossbasis(df$O3_log, lag=Plag,
                                      argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                                      arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Pknots))
              cb_PM25_log <- crossbasis(df$PM25_sqrt, lag=Plag,
                                         argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                                         arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Pknots))

              # Fit the model
              model <- glm(DengueCases ~  cb_MeanT + cb_AvgHum + 
                             cb_WindSp_mph + cb_TotalRain_log +
                             cb_SO2_log + cb_NO2_log + cb_NO_log +
                             cb_CO_log +
                             cb_O3_log + cb_PM25_log +
                             ns(DOS, df=3*9) + factor(Month) + factor(DOW) +
                             factor(Holiday) + offset(log(Population)), family=quasipoisson(),
                           data=df)

              # Calculate qAIC
              # deviance_val <- deviance(model)
              # num_params <- length(coef(model))
              # qAIC_value <- deviance_val + 2 * num_params
              
              dispersion <- summary(model)$dispersion
              deviance <- model$deviance
              edf <- length(coef(model))  # number of parameters

              qloglik <- -deviance / (2 * dispersion)
              qAIC_value <- -2 * qloglik + 2 * edf


              # Update min_qAIC if a new lower value is found
              if (qAIC_value < min_qAIC) {
                min_qAIC <- qAIC_value
                best_params <- list(Mlag=Mlag, Mdof=Mdof, Mknots=Mknots,
                                    Plag=Plag, Pdof=Pdof, Pknots=Pknots,
                                    qAIC=min_qAIC)
              }
            }, silent=TRUE)
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# Output best parameters and corresponding minimum qAIC
print(best_params)
```

```{r}
# Initialize minimum qAIC and best parameters
min_qAIC <- Inf
best_params <- list()

# Grid search over crossbasis parameters
for (Mlag in 26:34) {
  for (Mdof in 2:3) {
    for (Mknots in 2:3) {
      for (Plag in 6:12) {
        for (Pdof in 2:3) {
          for (Pknots in 2:3) {

            # Log current parameter combination
            cat("Trying: Mlag =", Mlag, 
                "Mdof =", Mdof, "Mknots =", Mknots,
                "Plag =", Plag, "Pdof =", Pdof, "Pknots =", Pknots, "\n")

            try({
              # Create crossbasis terms for meteorological variables
              cb_HeatWaveDays <- crossbasis(df$HeatWaveDays, lag=Mlag,
                                            argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Mdof),
                                            arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Mknots))
              cb_MeanT <- crossbasis(df$MeanT, lag=Mlag,
                                    argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Mdof),
                                    arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Mknots))
              cb_AvgHum <- crossbasis(df$AvgHum, lag=Mlag,
                                      argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Mdof),
                                      arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Mknots))
              cb_WindSp_mph <- crossbasis(df$WindSp_mph, lag=Mlag,
                                          argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Mdof),
                                          arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Mknots))

              # Crossbasis for pollution variables
              cb_SO2_log <- crossbasis(df$SO2_log, lag=Plag,
                                       argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                                       arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Pknots))
              cb_CO_sqrt <- crossbasis(df$CO_sqrt, lag=Plag,
                                       argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                                       arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Pknots))
              cb_O3_log <- crossbasis(df$O3_log, lag=Plag,
                                      argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                                      arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Pknots))
              cb_PM25_sqrt <- crossbasis(df$PM25_sqrt, lag=Plag,
                                         argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                                         arglag=list(fun="ns", knots=Pknots))

              # Fit the model
              model <- glm(DengueCases ~ cb_HeatWaveDays + cb_MeanT + cb_AvgHum +
                             cb_WindSp_mph +
                             cb_SO2_log + cb_CO_sqrt + cb_O3_log + cb_PM25_sqrt +
                             ns(DOS, df=7*6) + factor(Month) + factor(DOW) +
                             factor(Holiday),
                           family=quasipoisson(), data=df)

              # Safeguard against log(0)
              mu_hat <- pmax(fitted(model), 1e-10)
              y <- model$y

              # Compute quasi-likelihood and qAIC
              quasi_likelihood <- sum(y * log(mu_hat) - mu_hat)
              p <- length(coef(model))
              qAIC_value <- -2 * quasi_likelihood + 2 * p

              cat("   -> qAIC =", qAIC_value, "\n")

              # Update if better
              if (qAIC_value < min_qAIC) {
                min_qAIC <- qAIC_value
                best_params <- list(
                  Mlag = Mlag, Mdof = Mdof, Mknots = Mknots,
                  Plag = Plag, Pdof = Pdof, Pknots = Pknots,
                  qAIC = min_qAIC
                )
              }
            }, silent = TRUE)
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# Output the best parameters
cat("\nBest Parameters Found:\n")
print(best_params)
```

```{r}
library(MASS)     # for glm.nb
library(lmtest)   # for dwtest
library(splines)
library(dlnm)
library(zoo)      # for lag

# Define maximum number of lags to test
max_lags <- 20

# Storage for results
dw_results <- numeric(max_lags)
aic_results <- numeric(max_lags)

# Loop over number of lagged residuals
for (n_lags in 1:max_lags) {
  
  # Create temp data
  df_temp <- df[-c(1:48), ]
  
  # Add lagged deviance residuals
  for (i in 1:n_lags) {
    df_temp[[paste0("lag_residuals", i)]] <- lag(residuals, i)
  }
  
  # Rebuild cross-basis objects
  cb_MeanT_temp <- ns(df_temp$MeanT, df=Mdof)
  
  cb_AvgHum_temp <- ns(df_temp$AvgHum, df=Mdof)
  
  # cb_TotalRain_temp <- ns(df_temp$TotalRain, knots=c(4, 16))
  
  cb_TotalRain_log_temp <- ns(df_temp$TotalRain_log, knots=c(1.6, 2.8))

  cb_WindSp_mph_temp <- ns(df_temp$WindSp_mph, df=Mdof)
  
  cb_SO2_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$SO2, lag=Plag,
                         argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                         arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))
  
  
  cb_SO2_log_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$SO2_log, lag=Plag,
                         argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                         arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_NO2_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$NO2, lag=Plag,
                          argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                          arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_NO2_log_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$NO2_log, lag=Plag,
                          argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                          arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_NO_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$NO, lag=Plag,
                          argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                          arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_NO_log_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$NO_log, lag=Plag,
                          argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                          arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_CO_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$CO, lag=Plag,
                         argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                         arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_CO_log_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$CO_log, lag=Plag,
                         argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                         arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_O3_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$O3, lag=Plag,
                        argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                        arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))


  cb_O3_log_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$O3_log, lag=Plag,
                        argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                        arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))


  cb_PM25_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$PM2.5, lag=Plag,
                           argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                           arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_PM25_log_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$PM25_log, lag=Plag,
                           argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                           arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_PM25_sqrt_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$PM25_sqrt, lag=Plag,
                           argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                           arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_PM10_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$PM10, lag=Plag,
                           argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                           arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))
  
  # Add week index
  df_temp$DOS <- seq_len(nrow(df_temp)) 
  
  # Construct lagged residual terms in model formula
  lag_terms <- paste0("lag_residuals", 1:n_lags, collapse = " + ")
  
  # Create model formula
  model_formula <- as.formula(paste(
    "DengueCases ~ ns(DOS, df=3*9) + cb_MeanT_temp + 
                      # cb_AvgHum_temp +
                      # cb_TotalRain_log_temp +
                      # cb_WindSp_mph_temp +
                      cb_SO2_log_temp + 
                      cb_NO2_log_temp + 
                      cb_CO_log_temp + 
                      cb_O3_log_temp + 
                      cb_PM25_log_temp + ", lag_terms,
    "+ factor(Month) +
    # factor(DOW) +
    factor(Holiday) + offset(log(Population))"
  ))
  
  # Fit negative binomial model
  model_temp <- glm.nb(model_formula, data = df_temp)
  
  # Save AIC
  aic_results[n_lags] <- AIC(model_temp)
  
  # Compute residuals and DW
  resids <- residuals(model_temp, type = "deviance")
  lm_temp <- lm(resids ~ 1)
  dw_stat <- dwtest(lm_temp)$statistic
  dw_results[n_lags] <- dw_stat
  
  cat("Completed lag:", n_lags, "AIC =", round(aic_results[n_lags], 2), 
      "DW =", round(dw_stat, 3), "\n")
}

# Plot both AIC and DW
par(mfrow = c(2,1))  # two plots vertically

# AIC plot
plot(1:max_lags, aic_results, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "Number of Lagged Residuals", ylab = "AIC",
     main = "AIC vs Number of Residual Lags")

# DW plot
plot(1:max_lags, dw_results, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "Number of Lagged Residuals", ylab = "Durbin-Watson Statistic",
     main = "DW Statistic vs Number of Residual Lags")
abline(h = 2, col = "blue", lty = 2)
```

```{r}
# Install and load the necessary libraries
install.packages("plotly")
library(plotly)

# Cross-prediction from dlnm
pred_MeanT <- crosspred(cb_MeanT_adj, model_resid_dev, 
                        cumul = TRUE, cen = 32, ci.level = 0.95, 
                        vcov = vcov(model_resid_dev))

# Example: Extract the values for x, y, and z (for plotting)
x <- pred_MeanT$argvar  # This is the temperature (Max Temp) values
y <- pred_MeanT$arglag  # This is the lag (Days) values
z <- pred_MeanT$z      # These are the Relative Risk (RR) values

# Create a matrix of z values to plot the surface
Z_matrix <- matrix(z, nrow = length(x), byrow = TRUE)

# Split the surface into upper and lower based on a condition (e.g., z > 1 or z <= 1)
z_upper <- ifelse(Z_matrix > 1, Z_matrix, NA)  # Upper surface (RR > 1)
z_lower <- ifelse(Z_matrix <= 1, Z_matrix, NA)  # Lower surface (RR <= 1)

# Create the plotly 3D plot
fig <- plot_ly() %>%
  
  # Upper surface (where RR > 1) with one color
  add_surface(x = x, y = y, z = z_upper, colorscale = list(c(0, 1), c('white', 'blue')), opacity = 0.7) %>%
  
  # Lower surface (where RR <= 1) with another color
  add_surface(x = x, y = y, z = z_lower, colorscale = list(c(0, 1), c('white', 'red')), opacity = 0.7) %>%
  
  # Set axis labels and the plot title
  layout(scene = list(
    xaxis = list(title = 'Maximum Temperature'),
    yaxis = list(title = 'Lag (Days)'),
    zaxis = list(title = 'Relative Risk (RR)')
  ), 
  title = "3D Surface Plot with Upper and Lower Surfaces Colored Differently")

# Show the plot
fig

```

```{r}
#Crossbasis Meteorological Factors (Mlag=Meteorological Lag, Mdof=Meteorological degree of freedom)

Mlag <- 30
Mdof <- 3
  
  
cb_HeatWaveDays <- crossbasis(df$HeatWaveDays, lag = Mlag,
                              argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = Mdof),
                              arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = Mdof))

cb_MeanT <- crossbasis(df$MeanT, lag = Mlag,
                      argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = Mdof),
                      arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = Mdof))

cb_AvgHum <- crossbasis(df$AvgHum, lag = Mlag,
                        argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = Mdof),
                        arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = Mdof))

# cb_TotalRain_log <- crossbasis(df$TotalRain_log, lag=30,
#                                argvar=list(fun="ns", df=3),
#                                arglag=list(fun="ns", df=3))

cb_WindSp_mph <- crossbasis(df$WindSp_mph, lag = Mlag,
                            argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = Mdof),
                            arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = Mdof))

cb_SolarRad <- crossbasis(df$SolarRad, lag = Mlag,
                          argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = Mdof),
                          arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = Mdof))



# # Function to generate interior equally spaced knots
# get_knots <- function(x, n_knots) {
#   rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
#   seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = n_knots + 2)[-c(1, n_knots + 2)]
# }
# 
# exposure_knots <- get_knots(df$TotalRain_log, 2)  # 2 internal knots = df 3
# lag_knots <- get_knots(0:30, 2)
# 
# cb_TotalRain_log <- crossbasis(df$TotalRain_log, lag = 36,
#   argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots = exposure_knots),
#   arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = lag_knots)
# )


#Crossbasis Air Pollutants (Plag=Pollution Lag, Mdof=Pollution degree of freedom)

Plag <- 10
Pdof <- 2

cb_SO2 <- crossbasis(df$SO2, lag = Plag,
                     argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = Pdof),
                     arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = Pdof))

cb_NO2 <- crossbasis(df$NO2, lag = Plag,
                     argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = Pdof),
                     arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = Pdof))

cb_CO <- crossbasis(df$CO, lag = Plag,
                    argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = Pdof),
                    arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = Pdof))

cb_O3 <- crossbasis(df$O3, lag = Plag,
                    argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = Pdof),
                    arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = Pdof))

cb_PM25 <- crossbasis(df$`PM2.5`, lag = Plag,
                      argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = Pdof),
                      arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = Pdof))

```

```{r}
model_2 <- glm(DengueCases ~ cb_HeatWaveDays + cb_MeanT + cb_AvgHum + 
               cb_WindSp_mph + cb_SolarRad +
               cb_SO2 + cb_NO2 + cb_CO + cb_O3 + 
               cb_PM25 + ns(DOS, df=21) + factor(Month) + 
               factor(DOW) + factor(Holiday), family=quasipoisson(), data=df)

```

```{r}
# Deviance of the model
deviance_val <- deviance(model_2)

# Number of parameters (including intercept)
num_params <- length(coef(model_2))

# Compute qAIC manually: qAIC = Deviance + 2 * Number of Parameters
qAIC_value <- deviance_val + 2 * num_params

# Print the qAIC
print(qAIC_value)
```

```{r}
# Define lag period (0 to 6 weeks)
lag_period <- 6  

# Cross-basis for Maximum Temperature (MeanT)
cb_MeanT <- crossbasis(df$MeanT, lag=lag_period,
                       argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),   # Non-linear exposure
                       arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))  # Lag structure

# Cross-basis for Heatwaves (HeatWaveDays)
cb_HeatWaveDays <- crossbasis(df$HeatWaveDays, lag=lag_period,
                    argvar = list(fun="ns", knots=c(2, 5)),
                    arglag = list(fun="ns", knots=c(2, 5)))

# Cross-basis for Absolute Humidity (AH)
cb_AH <- crossbasis(df$AH, lag=lag_period,
                    argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                    arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

# Cross-basis for Total Rainfall (TotalRain)
cb_TotalRain <- crossbasis(df$TotalRain, lag=lag_period,
                    argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                    arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

```

```{r}
HW_model <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=3*11) + cb_HeatWaveDays + cb_AH + cb_TotalRain + Month + Holiday, data=df)

pred_HW <- crosspred(cb_HeatWaveDays, HW_model, at = seq(0, 7, by=0.1), 
                  cumul = TRUE, cen = 0, ci.level = 0.95, 
                  vcov = vcov(HW_model))
plot(pred_HW, "overall", xlab = "Total Number of Heatwave Days in a Week", ylab = "RR", 
     main = "Overall Exposure-Response Relationship")

```

```{r}
HW_model <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=3*11) + cb_HeatWaveDays + cb_AH + cb_TotalRain, data=df)
```

```{r}
gvif_values <- vif(HW_model)
print(gvif_values)
```

```{r}
# Extract deviance residuals from the model
residuals_nb_HW <- residuals(HW_model, type = "deviance", na.action = na.exclude)
```

```{r}
# Load necessary package
library(stats)

# Plot ACF (Autocorrelation Function)
acf(residuals_nb_HW, main = "ACF of Deviance Residuals")

# Plot PACF (Partial Autocorrelation Function)
pacf(residuals_nb_HW, main = "PACF of Deviance Residuals")

# Interpretation:
#     If significant spikes are present in ACF, residuals are autocorrelated.
#     If significant spikes are in PACF, specific lag terms may be needed to correct autocorrelation.
```

```{r}
#check the length of your residuals_nb
length(residuals_nb_HW)  #should show 554

# If residuals_nb is already 554 long, need to ensure it aligns with df_adj
# Create the adjusted dataframe
df_HW_adj <- df[-c(1:6), ]

# Create lag variables directly in df_adj
# If residuals_nb is already the correct length (554)
df_HW_adj$lag_residuals1 <- lag(residuals_nb_HW, 1)
df_HW_adj$lag_residuals2 <- lag(residuals_nb_HW, 2)

# Recreate cross-basis objects with the adjusted data
cb_HeatWaveDays_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_adj$HeatWaveDays, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", knots=c(2, 5)),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", knots=c(2, 5)))

cb_AH_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_adj$AH, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

cb_TotalRain_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_adj$TotalRain, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

# Create week variable
df_HW_adj$Week <- seq_len(nrow(df_HW_adj))
rownames(df_HW_adj) <- NULL

# Fit the model using these new cross-basis objects
HW_model_adj <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=3*11) + cb_HeatWaveDays_adj +
                     cb_AH_adj + cb_TotalRain_adj + lag_residuals1 +
                     lag_residuals2,
                   data=df_HW_adj)

pred_HW <- crosspred(cb_HeatWaveDays_adj, HW_model_adj, at = seq(0, 7, by=0.1), 
                  cumul = TRUE, cen = 0, ci.level = 0.95, 
                  vcov = vcov(HW_model_adj))

# crosspred() extracts effect estimates from the cb_HeatWaveDays cross-basis function.
# at = 0:6 ensures estimates are extracted for lag weeks 0 to 6.
# cumul = TRUE sums up the effect estimates over the full lag period.
#explicitly set a centering value (cen)
```

```{r}

for (n_HW in n_HW_values) {
  RR_HW <- pred_HW$allRRfit[which(pred_HW$predvar == n_HW)]
  CI_low_HW <- pred_HW$allRRlow[which(pred_HW$predvar == n_HW)]
  CI_high_HW <- pred_HW$allRRhigh[which(pred_HW$predvar == n_HW)]
  
  # Print the results
  cat("RR for", n_HW, "HeatWave Days:", RR_HW, "(95% CI: ", CI_low_HW, ",", CI_high_HW,")\n\n")
}
```

##(a) accounted for the trend and seasonality with 5 degrees of freedom per year
```{r}
HW_model_5dfyear <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=5*11) + cb_HeatWaveDays + cb_AH + cb_TotalRain, data=df)

residuals_nb_HW_5dfyear <- residuals(HW_model_5dfyear, type = "deviance", na.action = na.exclude)

#length(residuals_nb_HW_5dfyear)  #should show 554

# Create lag variables directly in df_adj
# If residuals_nb is already the correct length (554)
df_HW_5dfyear_adj$lag_residuals1 <- lag(residuals_nb_HW_5dfyear, 1)
df_HW_5dfyear_adj$lag_residuals2 <- lag(residuals_nb_HW_5dfyear, 2)

# Recreate cross-basis objects with the adjusted data
cb_HeatWaveDays_5dfyear_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_5dfyear_adj$HeatWaveDays, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", knots=c(2, 5)),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", knots=c(2, 5)))

cb_AH_5dfyear_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_5dfyear_adj$AH, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

cb_TotalRain_5dfyear_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_5dfyear_adj$TotalRain, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

# Create week variable
df_HW_5dfyear_adj$Week <- seq_len(nrow(df_HW_5dfyear_adj))
rownames(df_HW_5dfyear_adj) <- NULL

# Fit the model using these new cross-basis objects
HW_model_5dfyear_adj <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=5*11) + cb_HeatWaveDays_5dfyear_adj +
                     cb_AH_5dfyear_adj + cb_TotalRain_5dfyear_adj + lag_residuals1
                     + lag_residuals2,
                   data=df_HW_5dfyear_adj)

pred_HW_5dfyear <- crosspred(cb_HeatWaveDays_5dfyear_adj, HW_model_5dfyear_adj, at = seq(0, 7, by=0.1), 
                  cumul = TRUE, cen = 0, ci.level = 0.95,

plot(pred_HW_5dfyear, "overall", xlab = "Total Number of Heatwave Days in a Week", ylab = "RR", 
     main = "Overall Exposure-Response Relationship \n Natural Cubic Spline of Time (Week) with 5 df per Year")
```

```{r}
cb_AH_SA_a_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_SA_a_adj$AH, lag=lag_period,

cb_TotalRain_SA_a_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_SA_a_adj$TotalRain, lag=lag_period,

                              cb_HeatWaveDays_SA_a_adj +
```

```{r}
# Define lag period (0 to 6 weeks)
lag_period <- 6  

# Cross-basis for Heatwaves (HeatWaveDays)

residuals_nb_HW_SA_b <- residuals(HW_model_SA_b, type = "deviance", na.action = na.exclude)

#check the length of your residuals_nb

df_HW_SA_b_adj$lag_residuals1 <- lag(residuals_nb_HW_SA_b, 1)
df_HW_SA_b_adj$lag_residuals2 <- lag(residuals_nb_HW_SA_b, 2)

# Recreate cross-basis objects with the adjusted data
cb_HeatWaveDays_SA_b_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_SA_b_adj$HeatWaveDays, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", knots=c(2, 6)),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns",  df = 3))

cb_AH_SA_b_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_SA_b_adj$AH, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

cb_TotalRain_SA_b_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_SA_b_adj$TotalRain, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

# Create week variable
df_HW_SA_b_adj$Week <- seq_len(nrow(df_HW_SA_b_adj))
rownames(df_HW_SA_b_adj) <- NULL

# Fit the model using these new cross-basis objects
HW_model_SA_b_adj <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=3*11) +
                              cb_HeatWaveDays_SA_b_adj +
                     cb_AH_SA_b_adj + cb_TotalRain_SA_b_adj + lag_residuals1 +
                     lag_residuals2,
                   data=df_HW_SA_b_adj)

pred_HW_SA_b <- crosspred(cb_HeatWaveDays_SA_b_adj, HW_model_SA_b_adj, 
                          at = seq(0, 7, by=0.1), 
                  cumul = TRUE, cen = 0, ci.level = 0.95, 
                  vcov = vcov(HW_model_SA_b_adj))

plot(pred_HW_SA_b, "overall", xlab = "Total Number of Heatwave Days in a Week", ylab = "RR", main = "2 internal knots at 2 and 6 heatwave days (3 df)")
```

```{r}
}
```

```{r}
colnames(HW_95_2_counts) <- c("HeatWaveDays", "Count")

print(HW_95_2_counts)
```

```{r}

lag_period <- 6  

# Cross-basis for Heatwaves (HeatWaveDays)
cb_HW_95_2 <- crossbasis(df$HW_95_2, lag=lag_period,
                    argvar = list(fun="ns", knots=c(2, 5)),
                    arglag = list(fun="ns", knots=c(2, 5)))

HW_95_2_model <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=3*11) + cb_HW_95_2 + cb_AH + cb_TotalRain, data=df)

residuals_nb_HW_95_2 <- residuals(HW_95_2_model, type = "deviance", na.action = na.exclude)

#check the length of your residuals_nb
#length(residuals_nb_HW_SA_a)  #should show 554

# Create the adjusted dataframe
df_HW_95_2_adj <- df[-c(1:6), ]

# Create lag variables
df_HW_95_2_adj$lag_residuals1 <- lag(residuals_nb_HW_95_2, 1)
df_HW_95_2_adj$lag_residuals2 <- lag(residuals_nb_HW_95_2, 2)

# Recreate cross-basis objects with the adjusted data
cb_HW_95_2_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_95_2_adj$HW_95_2, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", knots=c(2, 5)),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", knots=c(2, 5)))

cb_AH_95_2_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_95_2_adj$AH, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

cb_TotalRain_95_2_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_95_2_adj$TotalRain, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

# Create week variable
df_HW_95_2_adj$Week <- seq_len(nrow(df_HW_95_2_adj))
rownames(df_HW_95_2_adj) <- NULL

# Fit the model using these new cross-basis objects
HW_95_2_model_adj <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=3*11) +
                              cb_HW_95_2_adj +
                     cb_AH_95_2_adj + cb_TotalRain_95_2_adj + lag_residuals1 +
                     lag_residuals2,
                   data=df_HW_95_2_adj)

pred_HW_95_2 <- crosspred(cb_HW_95_2_adj, HW_95_2_model_adj, 
                          at = seq(0, 7, by=0.1), 
                  cumul = TRUE, cen = 0, ci.level = 0.95, 
                  vcov = vcov(HW_95_2_model_adj))

plot(pred_HW_95_2, "overall", xlab = "Total Number of Heatwave Days in a Week", ylab = "RR", main = "MeanT > 95 Percentile Temp (36.3°C) for 2 or more Consecutive Days")

```

```{r}
# Define the heatwave days you want to analyze
n_HW_values <- c(3, 6)

# Loop through each heatwave day and extract RR and CI
for (n_HW in n_HW_values) {
  RR_HW <- pred_HW_95_2$allRRfit[which(pred_HW_95_2$predvar == n_HW)]
  CI_low_HW <- pred_HW_95_2$allRRlow[which(pred_HW_95_2$predvar == n_HW)]
  CI_high_HW <- pred_HW_95_2$allRRhigh[which(pred_HW_95_2$predvar == n_HW)]
  
  # Print the results
  cat("RR for", n_HW, "HeatWave Days:", RR_HW, "(95% CI: ", CI_low_HW, ",", CI_high_HW,")\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
MeanT_model <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=3*11) + cb_MeanT + cb_AH + cb_TotalRain, data=df)
```

```{r}
# Extract deviance residuals from the model
residuals_nb_MeanT <- residuals(MeanT_model, type = "deviance", na.action = na.exclude)
```

```{r}
# Load necessary package
library(stats)

# Plot ACF (Autocorrelation Function)
acf(residuals_nb_MeanT, main = "ACF of Deviance Residuals")

# Plot PACF (Partial Autocorrelation Function)
pacf(residuals_nb_MeanT, main = "PACF of Deviance Residuals")

# Interpretation:
#     If significant spikes are present in ACF, residuals are autocorrelated.
#     If significant spikes are in PACF, specific lag terms may be needed to correct autocorrelation.
```

```{r}
#check the length of your residuals_nb
length(residuals_nb_MeanT)  #should show 554

# If residuals_nb is already 554 long, need to ensure it aligns with df_adj
# Create the adjusted dataframe
df_MeanT_adj <- df[-c(1:6), ]

# Create lag variables directly in df_adj
# If residuals_nb is already the correct length (554)
df_MeanT_adj$lag_residuals1 <- lag(residuals_nb_MeanT, 1)
df_MeanT_adj$lag_residuals2 <- lag(residuals_nb_MeanT, 2)

# Recreate cross-basis objects with the adjusted data
cb_MeanT_adj <- crossbasis(df_MeanT_adj$MeanT, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

cb_AH_adj <- crossbasis(df_MeanT_adj$AH, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

cb_TotalRain_adj <- crossbasis(df_MeanT_adj$TotalRain, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

# Create week variable
df_MeanT_adj$Week <- seq_len(nrow(df_MeanT_adj))
rownames(df_MeanT_adj) <- NULL

# Fit the model using these new cross-basis objects
MeanT_model_adj <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=3*11) + cb_MeanT_adj +
                     cb_AH_adj + cb_TotalRain_adj + lag_residuals1 +
                     lag_residuals2,
                   data=df_MeanT_adj)

# This should now work properly
pred_MeanT <- crosspred(cb_MeanT_adj, MeanT_model_adj, at = seq(20,39, by=.1), 
                       cumul = TRUE, cen = 31.5, ci.level = 0.95, 
                       vcov = vcov(MeanT_model_adj))  
```

#Varying the degrees of freedom specified for the non-linear and lagged effects in the MeanT cross-basis matrix.
```{r}
# Define lag period (0 to 6 weeks)
lag_period <- 6  

# Cross-basis for Maximum Temperature (MeanT)
cb_MeanT_df4 <- crossbasis(df$MeanT, lag=lag_period,
                       argvar = list(fun="ns", df=4),   # Non-linear exposure
                       arglag = list(fun="ns", df=4))   # Lag structure

cb_MeanT_df5 <- crossbasis(df$MeanT, lag=lag_period,
                       argvar = list(fun="ns", df=5),   # Non-linear exposure
                       arglag = list(fun="ns", df=5))   # Lag structure

```

#MeanT_model_df4
```{r}
MeanT_model_df4 <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=3*11) + cb_MeanT_df4 + cb_AH + cb_TotalRain, data=df)

residuals_nb_MeanT_df4 <- residuals(MeanT_model_df4, type = "deviance", na.action = na.exclude)

df_MeanT_adj_df4 <- df[-c(1:6), ]

# Create lag variables directly in df_adj
# If residuals_nb is already the correct length (554)
df_MeanT_adj_df4$lag_residuals1 <- lag(residuals_nb_MeanT_df4, 1)
df_MeanT_adj_df4$lag_residuals2 <- lag(residuals_nb_MeanT_df4, 2)

# Recreate cross-basis objects with the adjusted data
cb_MeanT_adj_df4 <- crossbasis(df_MeanT_adj_df4$MeanT, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=4),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=4))

cb_AH_adj_df4 <- crossbasis(df_MeanT_adj_df4$AH, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

cb_TotalRain_adj_df4 <- crossbasis(df_MeanT_adj_df4$TotalRain, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

# Create week variable
df_MeanT_adj_df4$Week <- seq_len(nrow(df_MeanT_adj_df4))
rownames(df_MeanT_adj_df4) <- NULL

# Fit the model using these new cross-basis objects
MeanT_model_adj_df4 <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=3*11) + cb_MeanT_adj_df4 +
                     cb_AH_adj_df4 + cb_TotalRain_adj_df4 + lag_residuals1 +
                     lag_residuals2,
```

```{r}

lag_period <- 6

# Cross-basis for Maximum Temperature (MeanT)
cb_MeanT <- crossbasis(df$MeanT, lag=lag_period,
                       argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),   # Non-linear exposure
                       arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))  # Lag structure

# Cross-basis for Heatwaves (HeatWaveDays)
cb_HeatWaveDays <- crossbasis(df$HeatWaveDays, lag=lag_period,
                    argvar = list(fun="ns", knots=c(2, 5)),
                    arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

# Cross-basis for Absolute Humidity (AH)
cb_AH <- crossbasis(df$AH, lag=lag_period,
                    argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                    arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

# Cross-basis for Total Rainfall (TotalRain)
cb_TotalRain <- crossbasis(df$TotalRain, lag=lag_period,
                    argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                    arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))


HW_model <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=3*11) + cb_HeatWaveDays + cb_AH + cb_TotalRain, data=df)

residuals_nb_HW <- residuals(HW_model, type = "deviance", na.action = na.exclude)
df_HW_adj <- df[-c(1:6), ]

df_HW_adj$lag_residuals1 <- lag(residuals_nb_HW, 1)
df_HW_adj$lag_residuals2 <- lag(residuals_nb_HW, 2)

cb_HeatWaveDays_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_adj$HeatWaveDays, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", knots=c(2, 5)),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

cb_AH_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_adj$AH, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

cb_TotalRain_adj <- crossbasis(df_HW_adj$TotalRain, lag=lag_period,
                   argvar = list(fun="ns", df=3),
                   arglag = list(fun="ns", df=3))

df_HW_adj$Week <- seq_len(nrow(df_HW_adj))
rownames(df_HW_adj) <- NULL

HW_model_adj <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ ns(Week, df=3*11) + cb_HeatWaveDays_adj +
                     cb_AH_adj + cb_TotalRain_adj + lag_residuals1 +
                     lag_residuals2,
                   data=df_HW_adj)

pred_HW <- crosspred(cb_HeatWaveDays_adj, HW_model_adj, at = seq(0, 7, by=0.1), 
                  cumul = TRUE, cen = 0, ci.level = 0.95, 
                  vcov = vcov(HW_model_adj))

residuals_nb_HW_adj <- residuals(HW_model_adj, type = "deviance", na.action = na.exclude)
plot(pred_HW, "overall", xlab = "Number of Heatwave Days in a Week", ylab = "RR", 
     main = "Lag 6")
```

```{r}
# Select numeric predictors only

                     "SolarRad","SO2","NO2","NO","CO","O3","PM2.5","PM10",
                     "HeatWaveDays","HI","Population")]
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
#  Publication-Quality PCA Analysis
#  Dataset: Environmental & Meteorological Predictors (17 variables)
#  Outputs : (A) Scree plot  (B) Biplot — combined panel figure
#  Formats : 600 dpi TIFF (LZW) + vector PDF  |  180 mm wide (two-column)
# =============================================================================

# ── 0. Packages ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pkgs <- c("ggplot2", "ggrepel", "dplyr", "patchwork", "RColorBrewer")
invisible(lapply(pkgs, function(p) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(p)
  library(p, character.only = TRUE)
}))

# =============================================================================
#  1.  YOUR DATA — paste your pipeline here exactly as you had it
# =============================================================================
predictors <- df[, c("MaxT","MeanT","TotalRain","AvgHum","AH","WindSp_mph",
                     "SolarRad","SO2","NO2","NO","CO","O3","PM2.5","PM10",
                     "HeatWaveDays","HI","Population")]
predictors        <- na.omit(predictors)
predictors_scaled <- scale(predictors)
pca_result        <- prcomp(predictors_scaled, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# =============================================================================
#  2.  Thematic variable grouping — drives arrow colours in the biplot
#      Adjust membership if your dataset differs
# =============================================================================
var_names <- c("MaxT","MeanT","TotalRain","AvgHum","AH","WindSp_mph",
               "SolarRad","SO2","NO2","NO","CO","O3","PM2.5","PM10",
               "HeatWaveDays","HI","Population")

var_groups <- data.frame(
  Variable = var_names,
  Theme    = c(
    # Meteorology (7)
    "Meteorology","Meteorology","Meteorology","Meteorology",
    "Meteorology","Meteorology","Meteorology",
    # Air pollutants (7)
    "Air Pollutant","Air Pollutant","Air Pollutant",
    "Air Pollutant","Air Pollutant","Air Pollutant","Air Pollutant",
    # Derived / socio-environmental (3)
    "Derived / Socio-env.","Derived / Socio-env.","Derived / Socio-env."
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

theme_colours <- c(
  "Meteorology"          = "#1B7837",    # green
  "Air Pollutant"        = "#C51B7D",    # magenta
  "Derived / Socio-env." = "#2166AC"     # blue
)

# =============================================================================
#  3.  Variance data for scree plot
# =============================================================================
importance <- summary(pca_result)$importance
pct_var    <- importance[2, ] * 100      # % variance per PC
cum_var    <- importance[3, ] * 100      # cumulative %
n_pcs      <- length(pct_var)

scree_df <- data.frame(
  PC     = factor(paste0("PC", 1:n_pcs), levels = paste0("PC", 1:n_pcs)),
  PctVar = pct_var,
  CumVar = cum_var
)

cutoff_pc <- which(cum_var >= 80)[1]   # first PC reaching 80 % cumulative

# =============================================================================
#  4.  PANEL A — Scree plot
# =============================================================================
p_scree <- ggplot(scree_df, aes(x = PC)) +

  geom_col(
    aes(y    = PctVar,
        fill = as.integer(PC) <= cutoff_pc),
    colour    = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    width     = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#4393C3", "FALSE" = "#D1E5F0"),
    guide  = "none"
  ) +

  # Cumulative variance line
  geom_line(aes(y = CumVar, group = 1),
            colour = "#D6604D", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(y = CumVar),
             colour = "#D6604D", size = 1.8,
             shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.7) +

  # 80 % reference
  geom_hline(yintercept = 80, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = n_pcs * 0.97, y = 81.8,
           label = "80%", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30", hjust = 1) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    name     = "Variance explained (%)",
    limits   = c(0, 105),
    breaks   = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand   = c(0, 0),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = "Cumulative variance (%)",
                        breaks = seq(0, 100, 20))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Principal component", tag = "A") +

  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.border       = element_rect(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.title         = element_text(size = 9,  colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 7,  colour = "black",
                                      angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 8,  colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks         = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.35),
    axis.ticks.length  = unit(1.5, "mm"),
    plot.margin        = margin(4, 6, 4, 4, "mm"),
    plot.tag           = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
  )

# =============================================================================
#  5.  Biplot data prep
# =============================================================================
pct1 <- round(pct_var[1], 1)
pct2 <- round(pct_var[2], 1)

scores   <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:2])
colnames(scores) <- c("PC1", "PC2")

loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_result$rotation[, 1:2])
colnames(loadings) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
loadings$Variable  <- rownames(loadings)
loadings           <- left_join(loadings, var_groups, by = "Variable")

# Scale loadings into scores space
sf <- min(
  diff(range(scores$PC1)) / diff(range(loadings$PC1)),
  diff(range(scores$PC2)) / diff(range(loadings$PC2))
) * 0.42

loadings <- loadings %>%
  mutate(xend = PC1 * sf, yend = PC2 * sf)

# =============================================================================
#  6.  PANEL B — Biplot
# =============================================================================
p_biplot <- ggplot() +

  # Observation scores
  geom_point(
    data   = scores,
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2),
    shape  = 16, size = 1.3,
    colour = "grey55", alpha = 0.55
  ) +

  # Origin reference lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted",
             colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted",
             colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.3) +

  # Loading arrows, coloured by theme
  geom_segment(
    data = loadings,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = xend, yend = yend, colour = Theme),
    arrow     = arrow(length = unit(0.18, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    linewidth = 0.65
  ) +

  # Variable labels — non-overlapping
  geom_text_repel(
    data          = loadings,
    aes(x = xend, y = yend, label = Variable, colour = Theme),
    size          = 2.6,
    fontface      = "italic",
    box.padding   = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.15,
    segment.size  = 0.25,
    segment.alpha = 0.6,
    max.overlaps  = Inf,
    show.legend   = FALSE,
    seed          = 42
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(name = "Variable theme", values = theme_colours) +
  labs(
    x   = paste0("PC1 (", pct1, "%)"),
    y   = paste0("PC2 (", pct2, "%)"),
    tag = "B"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.border      = element_rect(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 9,  colour = "black"),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 8,  colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.35),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(1.5, "mm"),
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 8,  face = "bold"),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 7.5),
    legend.key.size   = unit(3.5, "mm"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80",
                                     linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.direction  = "horizontal",
    plot.margin       = margin(4, 4, 4, 4, "mm"),
    plot.tag          = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
  ) +
  coord_fixed()

# =============================================================================
#  7.  Combine panels
# =============================================================================
fig <- p_scree + p_biplot +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.4))

# =============================================================================
#  8.  Export
# =============================================================================
out_dir <- "."   # ← set your output folder path here

ggsave(
  filename    = file.path(out_dir, "pca_biplot_publication.tiff"),
  plot        = fig,
  width       = 180,       # mm — standard two-column width
  height      = 90,        # mm
  units       = "mm",
  dpi         = 600,
  compression = "lzw"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "pca_biplot_publication.pdf"),
  plot     = fig,
  width    = 180,
  height   = 90,
  units    = "mm",
  device   = cairo_pdf     # embeds fonts correctly
)

print(fig)
message("✓  Saved: pca_biplot_publication.tiff  +  pca_biplot_publication.pdf")

# =============================================================================
#  9.  Console summary for Methods / Supplementary Table
# =============================================================================
cat("\n══ Variance Explained (%) ══════════════════════════════\n")
vt <- summary(pca_result)$importance
print(round(vt * 100, 2)[, 1:min(10, ncol(vt))])

cat("\n══ Top 5 loadings — PC1 ════════════════════════════════\n")
print(sort(abs(pca_result$rotation[, 1]), decreasing = TRUE)[1:5])
cat("\n══ Top 5 loadings — PC2 ════════════════════════════════\n")
print(sort(abs(pca_result$rotation[, 2]), decreasing = TRUE)[1:5])
```

#Wavelet Analysis

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# WAVELET TRANSFORM COHERENCE (WTC) ANALYSIS
# Dengue Cases vs. Air Pollutants — Daily Time Series
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Methodology: Torrence & Compo (1998), Grinsted et al. (2004)
# Package:     biwavelet (Gouhier et al.)
# Reference:   Cazelles et al. (2008) Ecol. Lett.; Tian et al. (2018) Sci Total Environ
# =============================================================================

# ── 0. PACKAGES ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
required_packages <- c(
  "biwavelet",   # Core WTC engine (Grinsted et al. 2004 implementation)
  "tidyverse",   # Data wrangling
  "lubridate",   # Date handling
  "ggplot2",     # Publication plots
  "gridExtra",   # Multi-panel layout
  "viridis",     # Colour scales
  "scales",      # Axis formatting
  "tseries",     # ADF unit-root test
  "forecast",    # ARIMA pre-whitening
  "zoo",         # Rolling functions
  "writexl",     # Export results table
  "cowplot"      # Plot composition
)

install_if_needed <- function(pkg) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pkg)
}
invisible(lapply(required_packages, install_if_needed))
invisible(lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

# ── 1. LOAD & PREPARE DATA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(readxl)
df <- read_excel("C:/Users/ahnaf/Desktop/Personal/MSC/M.Sc. Thesis/Dengue/Air Pollutant_Dengue/Data/Daily_Dengue_Climate_PollutionDataDhakaCity_2016_2024.xlsx"
                 #, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
                 )

# Parse date
df$Date <- as.Date(df$Date)

# Sort by date (mandatory for wavelet)
df <- df %>% arrange(Date)

# Define the air-pollutant variables to analyse
pollutants <- c("SO2", "NO2", "NO", "CO", "O3", "PM2.5", "PM10")

# Check for missing values — interpolate short gaps (≤7 days) with spline
for (v in c("DengueCases", pollutants)) {
  if (any(is.na(df[[v]]))) {
    df[[v]] <- na.spline(df[[v]], na.rm = FALSE, maxgap = 7)
    message(sprintf("Interpolated NAs in %s", v))
  }
}

```

```{r}
# ── 2. STATIONARITY TEST (ADF) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Wavelet coherence does NOT require stationarity, but reporting it is standard
adf_results <- lapply(c("DengueCases", pollutants), function(v) {
  test <- adf.test(na.omit(df[[v]]), alternative = "stationary")
  data.frame(Variable = v,
             ADF_stat  = round(test$statistic, 3),
             p_value   = round(test$p.value,   4),
             Stationary = ifelse(test$p.value < 0.05, "Yes", "No"))
})
adf_table <- do.call(rbind, adf_results)
print(adf_table)

# ── 3. (OPTIONAL) PRE-WHITENING ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Some authors pre-whiten before WTC to reduce spurious coherence from
# autocorrelation. Toggle prewhiten = TRUE to enable; FALSE uses raw series.
prewhiten <- FALSE

prewhiten_series <- function(x) {
  fit  <- auto.arima(x, max.p = 3, max.q = 3, stationary = FALSE,
                     ic = "aic", stepwise = TRUE)
  resid(fit)
}

if (prewhiten) {
  message("Pre-whitening time series with ARIMA...")
  dengue_ts  <- prewhiten_series(df$DengueCases)
  poll_ts    <- lapply(pollutants, function(v) prewhiten_series(df[[v]]))
  names(poll_ts) <- pollutants
} else {
  dengue_ts  <- df$DengueCases
  poll_ts    <- setNames(lapply(pollutants, function(v) df[[v]]), pollutants)
}

```


```{r}
# ── 4. BUILD TIME MATRIX (required by biwavelet) ─────────────────────────────
# biwavelet expects a 2-column matrix: [time_index, value]
t_index <- 1:nrow(df)   # daily integer index

make_mat <- function(x) cbind(t_index, x)

dengue_mat <- make_mat(dengue_ts)

# ── 5. WTC PARAMETERS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Morlet mother wavelet (standard for ecological/epidemiological time series)
# n.sim = 1000 surrogate series for significance testing (AR(1) red-noise null)
# Pad  = TRUE: zero-pad series to next power of 2 (reduces edge effects)
# dj   = 0.25: sub-octave resolution (publication standard)
# s0   = 2*dt: minimum scale = 2 days
# J1   = 7/dj: maximum scale ~ 2 years for daily data

dt   <- 1          # sampling interval (1 day)
dj   <- 0.25       # scale resolution
s0   <- 2 * dt     # smallest scale
J1   <- round(7 / dj)   # ~2 years maximum period  # largest scale (oscillation period) = s0 × 2^(J1×dj)
n_sim <- 1000      # Monte Carlo surrogates (increase to 5000 for final paper)
ALPHA <- 0.05      # significance level

message(sprintf("WTC settings: dj=%.2f | s0=%d days | max period=%.0f days | n.sim=%d",
                dj, s0, s0 * 2^(J1 * dj), n_sim))

# ── 6. COMPUTE WTC FOR EACH POLLUTANT ────────────────────────────────────────
#This code is running a Wavelet Transform Coherence (WTC) analysis between DengueCases and each pollutant, and storing the results.

wtc_list <- list() #Creates an empty list to store results for each pollutant

for (poll in pollutants) { #Runs the same analysis for SO₂, NO₂, NO, CO, O₃, PM2.5, PM10
  message(sprintf("  Computing WTC: DengueCases ~ %s ...", poll))
  set.seed(2024)   # wtc() function uses Monte Carlo simulations These involve randomness"set.seed(2024)" is used in R to make random processes reproducible. "set.seed(2024)" ensures that:  Your results can be reproduced exactly Others running your code will get identical outputs.
  wtc_list[[poll]] <- wtc(
    d1     = dengue_mat, #first dataset (reference series), represents dengue cases over time, '*_mat' suggests it’s already formatted as a matrix
    d2     = make_mat(poll_ts[[poll]]), #a list of pollutant time series
    pad    = TRUE, #Adds zero-padding to reduce edge effects. Helps avoid distortion at the start/end of the series
    dj     = dj, #Controls frequency resolution; dj = 0.25 → fine-grained frequency detail
    s0     = s0, #The smallest scale (shortest period analyzed)
    J1     = J1, #Controls maximum period (longest cycle) analyzed
    mother = "morlet",
    sig.level = 1 - ALPHA,
    sig.test  = 0,       # 0 = pointwise test (checks significance at each time–scale point); 2 = time-averaged (scale-specific)
    nrands = n_sim #number of simulations for significance testing
  )
  message(sprintf("  Done: %s", poll))
}

# ── 7. PUBLICATION-QUALITY WTC PLOTS ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Colour scale: blue(−) → white(0) → red(+) for phase-adjusted power
# Arrows encode phase relationship:
#   →  in-phase (positive lead/lag = 0)
#   ←  anti-phase (180°)  one increases while the other decreases
#   ↑  y leads x by 90°   Pollutant leads dengue; Pollution changes happen before dengue changes
#   ↓  x leads y by 90°   

# Date axis labels (derived from DOS)
n_dates <- nrow(df)                                 # total number of days
year_breaks <- which(!duplicated(df$Year))          # first day of each year
year_labels <- df$Year[year_breaks]                 # corresponding year values

plot_wtc <- function(wtc_obj, poll_name, date_breaks, date_labels,
                     arrow_density = 15) {
  # Use base biwavelet plot with custom cosmetics
  plot(
    wtc_obj,
    plot.phase = TRUE,       # draw arrows
    lty.coi    = 1,
    col.coi    = "white",
    lwd.coi    = 2,
    lwd.sig    = 2,
    arrow.lwd  = 0.03,
    arrow.len  = 0.12,
    arrow.col  = "black",
    xlim       = c(1, n_dates),     # Covers full time range
    ylim       = log2(c(2, 730)),   # 2 days to 2 years
    xlab       = "Date",
    ylab       = "Period (days)",
    main       = bquote(bold("WTC: Dengue ~") ~ bold(.(poll_name))),
    xaxt       = "n",   #Removes default axes; replaced  manually (next step)
    yaxt       = "n",
    key.cols   = rev(heat.colors(64)),  # will be overridden below
    plot.cb    = FALSE
  )

  # Custom x-axis: year labels
  axis(1, at = date_breaks, labels = date_labels, las = 1, cex.axis = 0.85)

  # Custom y-axis: meaningful period labels (days)
  period_ticks <- c(2, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 182, 365, 730) #choice of time scales:  2 days, 1 week, 2 week, 1 month, 6 months, 1 year, 2 years,
  axis(2, at = log2(period_ticks), labels = period_ticks, las = 1, cex.axis = 0.85)

  # Cone of influence shading
  # polygon(
  #   c(wtc_obj$coi, rev(wtc_obj$coi)),
  #   c(log2(wtc_obj$period[1]), wtc_obj$coi,
  #     rep(log2(max(wtc_obj$period)), length(wtc_obj$coi))),
  #   col = rgb(1, 1, 1, 0.4), border = NA
  # )
}
```

```{r}
# ── 10. GLOBAL WAVELET SPECTRUM ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Time-averaged power across all periods — analogous to a Fourier power spectrum
plot_global_spectrum <- function(cwt_obj, label, col = "steelblue") {
  global_power <- rowMeans(Mod(cwt_obj$wave)^2)
  sig_global   <- cwt_obj$sig.fft          # theoretical red-noise background
  periods      <- cwt_obj$period

  plot(global_power, log2(periods),
       type = "l", col = col, lwd = 2,
       xlab = "Power", ylab = "Period (days)",
       main = paste0("Global Wavelet Spectrum\n", label),
       yaxt = "n")
  axis(2, at = log2(period_ticks), labels = period_ticks, las = 1)
  abline(v = max(sig_global) * 0.95, lty = 2, col = "red", lwd = 1.5)
  legend("topright", legend = c("Observed", "95% red-noise"),
         lty = c(1, 2), col = c(col, "red"), bty = "n")
}

png(file.path(output_dir, "GlobalSpectrum_DengueCases.png"),
    width = 1400, height = 1800, res = 300)
par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))
plot_global_spectrum(dengue_cwt, "Daily Dengue Cases")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# ── 11. QUANTITATIVE SUMMARY TABLE ───────────────────────────────────────────
# For each pollutant, extract:
#   (a) Mean coherence at biologically plausible period bands
#   (b) Proportion of time–frequency space with significant coherence
#   (c) Dominant phase angle (mean arrow direction in significant regions)

period_bands <- list(
  "Weekly (2–14 days)"   = c(2,   14),
  "Monthly (15–60 days)" = c(15,  60),
  "Seasonal (61–180 d)"  = c(61, 180),
  "Annual (181–400 d)"   = c(181, 400)
)

extract_band_stats <- function(wtc_obj, poll_name) {
  rsq   <- wtc_obj$rsq          # coherence squared  [period × time]
  sig   <- wtc_obj$sig.fft      # significance matrix (1 = significant)
  phase <- wtc_obj$phase        # phase angle [radians]
  per   <- wtc_obj$period

  rows <- lapply(names(period_bands), function(bname) {
    rng  <- period_bands[[bname]]
    idx  <- which(per >= rng[1] & per <= rng[2])
    if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)

    sub_rsq  <- rsq[idx, ]
    sub_sig  <- sig[idx, ]          # logical: TRUE where significant
    sub_phase <- phase[idx, ]

    mean_coh  <- round(mean(sub_rsq,                    na.rm = TRUE), 3)
    sig_prop  <- round(mean(sub_sig > wtc_obj$sig.level, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)
    # Mean phase in significant pixels
    sig_mask  <- sub_sig > wtc_obj$sig.level
    if (sum(sig_mask, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      mean_phase_deg <- round(mean(sub_phase[sig_mask], na.rm = TRUE) * 180 / pi, 1)
    } else {
      mean_phase_deg <- NA
    }

    # Interpret dominant phase
    phase_label <- dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(mean_phase_deg)                                    ~ "—",
      abs(mean_phase_deg) <= 45                                ~ "In-phase (synchronous)",
      mean_phase_deg > 45  & mean_phase_deg <= 135             ~ "Pollutant leads (~90°)",
      mean_phase_deg < -45 & mean_phase_deg >= -135            ~ "Dengue leads (~90°)",
      abs(mean_phase_deg) > 135                                ~ "Anti-phase",
      TRUE ~ "Mixed"
    )

    data.frame(
      Pollutant        = poll_name,
      Period_Band      = bname,
      Mean_Coherence   = mean_coh,
      Pct_Significant  = sig_prop,
      Mean_Phase_deg   = mean_phase_deg,
      Phase_Interpretation = phase_label,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), rows))
}

summary_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pollutants, function(p) {
  extract_band_stats(wtc_list[[p]], p)
}))

print(summary_table, row.names = FALSE)

# Export to Excel
write_xlsx(summary_table, file.path(output_dir, "WTC_Summary_Statistics.xlsx"))
message("Saved summary table.")
```

```{r}
# ── 13. SCALE-AVERAGED WAVELET POWER (SAWP) TIME SERIES ──────────────────────
# Time series of band-specific coherence — useful as a supplementary figure
# showing when coherence is strong at each period band

compute_sawp <- function(wtc_obj, period_min, period_max) {
  per  <- wtc_obj$period
  idx  <- which(per >= period_min & per <= period_max)
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(rep(NA, ncol(wtc_obj$rsq)))
  colMeans(wtc_obj$rsq[idx, ], na.rm = TRUE)
}

for (poll in pollutants) {
  sawp_weekly   <- compute_sawp(wtc_list[[poll]], 2,   14)
  sawp_monthly  <- compute_sawp(wtc_list[[poll]], 15,  60)
  sawp_seasonal <- compute_sawp(wtc_list[[poll]], 61, 180)
  sawp_annual   <- compute_sawp(wtc_list[[poll]], 181, 400)

  sawp_df <- data.frame(
    Date     = df$Date,
    Weekly   = sawp_weekly,
    Monthly  = sawp_monthly,
    Seasonal = sawp_seasonal,
    Annual   = sawp_annual
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Date, names_to = "Band", values_to = "Coherence") %>%
    mutate(Band = factor(Band, levels = c("Weekly", "Monthly", "Seasonal", "Annual")))

  p_sawp <- ggplot(sawp_df, aes(x = Date, y = Coherence, colour = Band)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~Band, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85) +
    labs(
      title    = sprintf("Scale-Averaged Wavelet Coherence: Dengue ~ %s", poll),
      subtitle = "By period band (mean WTC R² across time)",
      x        = "Date",
      y        = expression(Mean~Coherence~(R^2)),
      colour   = "Period Band"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, sprintf("SAWP_Dengue_%s.png", poll)),
         p_sawp, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
}
message("Saved SAWP figures.")
```

```{r}
# ── 14. PHASE ANGLE DISTRIBUTION (ROSE DIAGRAM) ───────────────────────────────
# For significant time–frequency pixels, visualise phase distribution per band

if (!requireNamespace("circular", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("circular")
library(circular)

plot_phase_rose <- function(wtc_obj, poll_name, period_min, period_max,
                            band_label, sig_level = 0.95) {
  per  <- wtc_obj$period
  idx  <- which(per >= period_min & per <= period_max)
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  phase_sub <- wtc_obj$phase[idx, ]
  sig_sub   <- wtc_obj$sig.fft[idx, ] > sig_level
  sig_phase <- na.omit(phase_sub[sig_sub])
  if (length(sig_phase) < 10) return(invisible(NULL))

  circ_phase <- circular(sig_phase, type = "angles", units = "radians",
                         zero = pi/2, rotation = "clock")

  rose.diag(circ_phase, bins = 24, col = "steelblue", prop = 2,
            main = sprintf("Phase distribution\nDengue ~ %s | %s", poll_name, band_label))
  arrows.circular(mean(circ_phase), col = "red", lwd = 2)
}

png(file.path(output_dir, "PhaseRose_Seasonal_Band.png"),
    width = 2400, height = 2400, res = 300)
par(mfrow = c(2, ceiling(n_poll / 2)), mar = c(2, 2, 3, 2))
for (poll in pollutants) {
  plot_phase_rose(wtc_list[[poll]], poll,
                  period_min = 61, period_max = 180,
                  band_label = "Seasonal (61-180 d)")
}
dev.off()
message("Saved phase rose diagrams.")
```

```{r}
year_labels <- format(Data$Date[year_index], "%Y")

axis(
1,
at = year_index,
labels = year_labels,
cex.axis = 1.3
)

dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(waveslim)
library(lmtest)

Data <- read_excel(
"C:/Users/ahnaf/Desktop/Personal/MSC/M.Sc. Thesis/Dengue/Air Pollutant_Dengue/Data/Daily_Dengue_Climate_PollutionDataDhakaCity_2016_2024.xlsx"
)

pollutants <- c("SO2", "NO2", "CO", "O3", "PM2.5", "PM10")

results <- data.frame()

for(pollutant in pollutants){

dengue <- na.omit(Data$DengueCases)
pollution <- na.omit(Data[[pollutant]])

# Wavelet decomposition

dengue.w <- modwt(dengue, wf = "haar", n.levels = 6)
poll.w   <- modwt(pollution, wf = "haar", n.levels = 6)

for(i in 1:6){


temp <- data.frame(
  dengue = dengue.w[[i]],
  pollutant = poll.w[[i]]
)

# Pollutant -> Dengue
gc1 <- grangertest(
  dengue ~ pollutant,
  order = 7,
  data = temp
)

# Dengue -> Pollutant
gc2 <- grangertest(
  pollutant ~ dengue,
  order = 7,
  data = temp
)

results <- rbind(
  results,
  data.frame(
    Pollutant = pollutant,
    Scale = paste0("D", i),
    Direction = paste0(pollutant, " -> Dengue"),
    Pvalue = gc1$`Pr(>F)`[2]
  ),
  data.frame(
    Pollutant = pollutant,
    Scale = paste0("D", i),
    Direction = paste0("Dengue -> ", pollutant),
    Pvalue = gc2$`Pr(>F)`[2]
  )
)


}
}

print(results)

write.csv(
results,
"C:/Users/ahnaf/Desktop/Personal/MSC/M.Sc. Thesis/Dengue/Air Pollutant_Dengue/Wavelet Analysis/Output/6Jun/Wavelet_Granger_Results.csv",
row.names = FALSE
)
```
